# hostereo_regions (Data Source)

Active regions (datacenters). Public; no API key needed.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "hostereo_regions" "all" {}

output "region_slugs" {
  value = [for r in data.hostereo_regions.all.regions : r.slug]
}
```
